notes: Four decks: FX buttons 1 / 3 pick deck A or C on the left, 2 / 4 deck B or D on the right (modifiers 5 and 6); every control of that side, the mixer channel included, follows. The controller sends SHIFT and each pad mode as other notes itself. Jogs: 720 counts per turn; SHIFT + jog at four times the speed. VINYL toggles turntable / jog mode per deck (it starts as turntable). 14-bit volume, EQ, gain and tempo, with soft takeover. Pads: Hot Cue (SHIFT deletes), Loop (1/8 to 16 beats; SHIFT 1/32, 1/16, 32 to 512), Sampler (deck C's cells), Key (semitone down / up; tempo range up / down over the app's list), FX (three slots of FX unit 1 / 2 and SHIFT next effect, channel to FX 1 / 2, filter on), Beat Jump (1 to 8 beats; SHIFT 16 to 128). Not mapped: Slicer and Roll pads, whole-tone and tempo range reset pads, filter chain preset pads, the filter knob moving the FX unit while an effect is on, SHIFT + VINYL brake, SHIFT + LOAD eject, SHIFT + SYNC key sync, SHIFT + LOOP IN / OUT jumps, crossfader curve and on/off switches, VU meters, beatmatch and deck number LEDs, pad colours (one colour per pad). Not mapped from the Mixxx file: [Library] MoveFocus, [AutoDJ] enabled, [Mixer Profile] DJCiN.crossfaderEnable, [Mixer Profile] DJCiN.crossfaderSetCurve, [ChannelN] DJCiN.deckA.slicerButtons[N].input, [ChannelN] DJCiN.deckA.rollButtons[N].input, [ChannelN] DJCiN.deckB.slicerButtons[N].input, [ChannelN] DJCiN.deckB.rollButtons[N].input, [Library] MoveHorizontal.
